Player & artwork / 播放器与绘图

The playback engine, interface, CSS enclosure, vector controls, curved lettering and procedural grain are project-authored and released under MIT. The included “First Spin” test composition and click sound are generated by this project.
播放引擎、界面、CSS 机身、矢量按钮、弧形文字及程序纹理由本项目编写，按 MIT 分发。预置测试音乐《转动之间》和按键音为本项目合成。

ChicagoKare / 英文字体

Font by Duane King, reproducing the Chicago bitmap typeface designed by Susan Kare. Obtained unchanged from KingDuane/Chicago-Kare, pinned commit dca7a9e…. Copyright © 2024 Duane King. The upstream repository’s MIT license is included. The unchanged font metadata also identifies Susan Kare and SIL OFL; this is recorded in the repository provenance.
作者 Duane King，复现 Susan Kare 设计的 Chicago 位图字形。文件直接来自固定上游提交，未修改字节；附完整上游 MIT 许可证，同时保留字体内部作者及 OFL 信息。

Copyright © 2014–2021 Adobe. Reserved Font Name “Source”. SIL Open Font License 1.1. From Google Fonts, pinned revision; converted to regular WOFF2 with all Unicode mappings retained.

Visual reference & names / 外观参考与名称

Apple Music’s web iPod was the visual reference. Apple’s original script, extracted skin, bitmap texture and saved comparison runtime are excluded from this public release. A source credit is not a redistribution license. Apple, iPod and Apple Music are third-party names and marks; MIT grants no trademark rights.
